body: Founder reported: 'i broke the server, tyler makes things wonky.' Root-caused via var/logs/matchmaker-bots.log: a full 20/20-connected lobby stuck at phase=1 forever, one CLIENT id never appearing in the pick log, dying on the server's own 60s no-progress timeout. draft_grid_origin/draft_screen_hero_at/draw_draft_screen computed the 6-col hero draft grid centered on win_w/2 with no clamp against the actual resizable window size -- fine at the 1280x720 default, but below ~1134px wide the rightmost column (hero_id % 6 == 5, which includes Tyler at id 17) rendered mostly or fully past the window edge: unclickable, or only clickable in a mislabeled sliver, so that player's PACKET_ARENA_PICK could never be sent. Server-side that's indistinguishable from an AFK client. Grid now shrinks/shifts to fit whatever window size is live at every column and row; verified with a standalone check that all 30 hero tiles land fully in-bounds from 1280px down to 500px wide. apps/arena/src/main.c 5916dc5, CHANGELOG 00e0aff.
title: fix: draft-grid pick screen overflowed narrower window widths, stuck real matches at 20/20
